title: AuthorizationDecision
description: The final enforcement decision for one operation/party as recorded in fixtures and consumed by the audit polyrepo. The on-chain form is a revert with a ContractError code; this is its structured documentation form.

decision.description: allow == the gate chain passed; deny == the operation must revert. There is deliberately no 'unknown': the enforcement layer is fail-closed.

reason.description: Present when decision is deny; the first failing gate in canonical order.
